protocol.sampling_note: Saved samples at one-second intervals, plus verified labeled frames. Both models receive identical decoded pixels. Comparison panels show the saved sample timestamp.
protocol.matching_note: All post-NMS proposals are paired to verified annotations by class- and score-blind maximum-cardinality IoU ≥ 0.5 matching, with summed IoU as the secondary objective; frozen copper thresholds are then applied.
protocol.notes: Generated locally on CPU with Torch 2.14.1 and Ultralytics 8.4.175. The historical development result used saved JPEG inputs, Torch 2.8.0 and a different alarm matcher. Selected-clip scores below are newly measured and kept separate. Label evidence covers 843 frames aligned to individual source images plus 136 frames mapped through verified publisher ordinals and recording-level checks.
